events.title: Custom Maps & Steam Workshop Added!
events.summary: Custom Maps & Steam Workshop Added!Custom map creation and Steam Workshop support have now been added to Stewart The Fox: Swing it! ahead of launch on January 14, 2027.At release, players will be able to build their own levels with spawn points, finishes, swing points, wall-jump sections, and more. Maps can be published directly to Steam Workshop, updated later, and played in-game after subscribing to any map.Happy creating!

events.title: Sweat Your Ass Off in Baron's Chase! Can You Escape?
events.summary: BARON VON FLAPPENSTEIN IS ON THE HUNT! Baron's Chase is a brand-new endless mode where your goal is simple: survive for as long as possible. RUN. SWING. DON'T GET CAUGHT. Run, swing, and wall jump through an endless course while Baron chases you from behind. Make a mistake and he'll start closing the distance. Get too slow, and you're getting carried away! events.title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it! Demo Available Now
events.summary: The free demo for Stewart The Fox: Swing it! is now available on Steam! 🎉 Experience the game's fast-paced momentum-based movement across 3 handcrafted speedrun levels. Demo Features: • 3 playable levels • Swinging, Walljumps & Momentum-Based Movement • Personal Best Ghosts • World Record Ghost Downloads • Instant Retry If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to wishlist the full game. Every wishlist helps support development!
